name: Card Authentication Data 1
definition: Contains authentication related data. such as 3DS authentication data.

AccountBasedDigitalSignature.name: Account Based Digital Signature
AccountBasedDigitalSignature.definition: Specifies that card authentication is performed using credentials linked to the cardholder’s account rather than the physical card.

CardholderCertificateSerialNumber.name: Cardholder Certificate Serial Number
CardholderCertificateSerialNumber.definition: Contains a value assigned to a Secure Electronic Commerce cardholder certificate issued by the acquirer's certificate authority.

AcceptorCertificateSerialNumber.name: Acceptor Certificate Serial Number
AcceptorCertificateSerialNumber.definition: Contains a value assigned to a secure electronic commerce merchant certificate issued by the acquirer's certificate authority.

MessageVersion.name: Message Version
MessageVersion.definition: The Protocol version number of the specification used by the system creating authentication message. Refer to Refer to EMV Specification Bulletin 255 for the format.

XID.name: XID
XID.definition: Contains a unique secure electronic commerce number generated by the merchant server to identify the transaction.

AuthenticationValue.name: Authentication Value
AuthenticationValue.definition: Payment System-specific value provided by the ACS or the DS using an algorithm defined by Payment System.

AuthenticationMerchantName.name: Authentication Merchant Name
AuthenticationMerchantName.definition: Merchant name assigned by the Acquirer or Payment System during the authentication.

DeviceInformation.name: Device Information
DeviceInformation.definition: Device information gathered by the 3DS SDK from a Consumer Device. This is JSON name/value pairs that as a whole is Base64url-encoded.

PurchaseAmount.name: Purchase Amount
PurchaseAmount.definition: Purchase amount in minor units of currency with all punctuation removed.

PurchaseCurrency.name: Purchase Currency
PurchaseCurrency.definition: Currency in which purchase amount is expressed.

PurchaseDateTime.name: Purchase Date Time
PurchaseDateTime.definition: Date and time of the authentication converted into UTC.

AddressMatchIndicator.name: Address Match Indicator
AddressMatchIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the Cardholder Shipping Address and Cardholder Billing Address are the same. |Valid value|Y = Shipping Address matches Billing Address||N = Shipping Address does not match Billing Address

IntermediaryTransactionIdentifier.name: Intermediary Transaction Identifier
IntermediaryTransactionIdentifier.definition: Universally unique transaction identifier assigned by the Intermediary entity to identify a single transaction.

AuthenticationServerTransactionIdentifie.name: Authentication Server Transaction Identifier
AuthenticationServerTransactionIdentifie.definition: Universally Unique transaction identifier assigned by the authentication server to identify a single transaction.

ApplicationIPAddress.name: Application IP Address
ApplicationIPAddress.definition: External IP address (that is the device public IP address) used by the 3DS Requestor App when it connects to the 3DS Requestor environment.

ShippingIndicator.name: Shipping Indicator
ShippingIndicator.definition: Indicates shipping method chosen for the transaction.

SDKApplicationIdentification.name: SDK Application Identification
SDKApplicationIdentification.definition: Universally unique identification (ID) that is created for each installation of the 3DS Requestor App on a Consumer Device.

DeviceIdentification.name: Device Identification
DeviceIdentification.definition: Unique and immutable identifier linked to a device that is consistent across 3DS transactions for the specific user device.  Refer to D021 in EMV 3-D secure SDK-Device Information.

DeviceType.name: Device Type
DeviceType.definition: Contain value to indicates the device type. Valid value refer to EMV 3-D Secure SDK Device Information.

RecurringTransactionSetup.name: Recurring Transaction Setup
RecurringTransactionSetup.definition: Indicate the status of recurring transaction data provided in the authentication.

ThirdPartyIdentification.name: Third Party Identification
ThirdPartyIdentification.definition: Identify the third party who provided the authentication service.

ThirdPartyRiskScore.name: Third Party Risk Score
ThirdPartyRiskScore.definition: Contains the Risk score provided by the third party service provider.

SessionIdentification.name: Session Identification
SessionIdentification.definition: Contains authentication service provider-generated unique identifier that identifies a transaction.

IPAddressVelocityCount.name: IP Address Velocity Count
IPAddressVelocityCount.definition: Contains the velocity count for the IP address of a 3D-secure transaction.

DeviceIdentificationVelocityCount.name: Device Identification Velocity Count
DeviceIdentificationVelocityCount.definition: Contains the velocity count for the device ID of a 3D-secure transaction.

DataQuality.name: Data Quality
DataQuality.definition: Indicate whether the transaction has suffiecient authentication data.

Programme.name: Programme
Programme.definition: Identifies the authentication solution used to process the transaction.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
